verdict.rationale: BugSnag has an official MCP server (SmartBear MCP) with recent OAuth 2.0 browser-login support for the self-hosted version, so a user can query and act on BugSnag data with natural-language commands through an external AI agent. There is no evidence of a native, in-product natural-language interface. The MCP route also depends on a third-party client, and the evidence does not say which operations it exposes. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which BugSnag actions the MCP tools cover, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
